title: Bound WebGL resources before promotion-kit extraction
summary: Bounded structural WebGL leases, exact native fallback, automatic queued resume, endpoint idle release, explicit session disposal, and context-loss recovery are implemented and verified without changing the compositor lifecycle taxonomy.

sourceRefs.intent: The human approved the repaired radical exemplar and requested one short generic resource-hardening slice before the approved loop resumes. Add explicit renderer-session disposal, eliminate repeated capability-probe contexts, bound active structural contexts with deterministic native fallback, and prove over-capacity behavior without adding a compositor, runtime, or notation-specific rule.
